title: About This Site
text:
This site explores scoring patterns in Major League Soccer using match records from Football-Data.co.uk. It compares matches before and after Lionel Messi’s arrival in July 2023 and highlights Inter Miami’s recorded results.
The comparisons are descriptive. They summarize match outcomes and do not establish that any one player caused league-wide changes.

title: MLS Match Scoring Before and After Messi
text: Match scoring rose modestly after July 21, 2023: average goals increased from 2.85 before the cutoff to 3.11 afterward. Draws remained about one quarter of matches (25.0% before and 25.7% after), and the average goal margin was nearly unchanged (1.31 versus 1.33). The records point to somewhat higher scoring, but not a clear shift in overall competitiveness. Since the cutoff, Inter Miami recorded 67 wins, 32 draws, and 24 losses in 123 matches, averaging 2.31 goals scored and 1.56 conceded per match. The source lists the club as “Inter Miami”; the chart highlights those matches in pink. These comparisons describe the records and do not establish that Messi caused league-wide changes.
